def quantiles(data):
    values = sorted(data)
    m = len(values) - 1
    result = []
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        j, delta = divmod(i * m, 4)
        result.append((values[j] * (4 - delta) + values[j + 1] * delta) / 4)
    return result

def quantiles(data):

    m = len(values) - 1
    result = []
    for i in range(1, 4):
        j = i * m // 4
        delta = i * m - j * 4
        result.append((values[j] * (4 - delta) + values[j + 1] * delta) / 4)
    return result

def quantiles(data):
    values = sorted(data)
    n = len(values)
    result = []
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        position = i * (n - 1) / 4
        lower = int(position)
        upper = min(lower + 1, n - 1)
        fraction = position - lower
        result.append(values[lower] + (values[upper] - values[lower]) * fraction)
    return result
